issue_context.title: Issues with Nexia integration showing unavailable on entities due to connection error
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Hi - I have noticed since updating HA to 2022.5.2 that periodically the state of my nexia/trane entities go 'unavailable' for about a minute and then seem to come back. What caused me to notice this was that some of my automatons were resetting. This was because all of the states for the nexia entities were refreshed when it fixed itself and logged them again. 

When I first looked at the logs I saw connection errors to www.tranehome.com. So I waited about a week to see if it was a connection issue on nexia side and it was still happening. I had just updated HA core to 2022.5.2 at that time and thought it could be related. I updated to version 5.3 and it still persisted. 

So I reverted back to a backup of core-2022.3.7 which was the version before I went to 5.2.  The issue does not show up. Smooth sailing for several hours where before interruptions would be about 1-2 per hour.

When doing an update to 5.4 (from the UI, not a backup) the issue presented it self again. Logs are pasted below. 

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.4.2, 5.2, 5.3, 5.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2022.3.7

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Nexia

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/nexia/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Logger: homeassistant.components.nexia.coordinator
Source: helpers/update_coordinator.py:204
Integration: Nexia/American Standard/Trane (documentation, issues)
First occurred: 5:29:39 PM (2 occurrences)
Last logged: 5:49:47 PM

Error requesting Nexia update data: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='www.tranehome.com', port=443): Max retries exceeded with url: /mobile/houses/REDACTED (Caused by NewConnectionError('<urllib3.connection.HTTPSConnection object at 0x7f9ab3007fa0>: Failed to establish a new connection: [Errno -3] Try again'))
Error requesting Nexia update data: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='www.tranehome.com', port=443): Max retries exceeded with url: /mobile/houses/REDACTED (Caused by NewConnectionError('<urllib3.connection.HTTPSConnection object at 0x7f9a99cd2eb0>: Failed to establish a new connection: [Errno -3] Try again'))
```


### Additional information

I tried doing some testing to see if I could find working version that was later than what I had. My 3.7 backup was not a full backup. Probably my error. I had good success with duplicating the issue and making it going away with going back and forth between 3.7 and 5.2, .3, .4 . Meaning whenever I went back to 3.7 the issue did not show up. 

However after taking a leap to 4.2 to test this, (which the issue was also present) and then reverting back to 3.7 I seem to now have brought the issue back with me to 3.7 

Even after a reboot, now this issue happens in 3.7 and I'm bummed about it because it messes with my automatons and I don't have a clean starting point anymore.
comments:
Hey there @bdraco, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`nexia`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L681) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

---

[nexia documentation](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/nexia)
[nexia source](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/tree/dev/homeassistant/components/nexia)
<sub><sup>(message by IssueLinks)</sup></sub>
Not much we can do with this one.  The cloud service is a bit flakey.  We backoff once we hit the retry limit.  This is expected behavior.

Sure - but that doesn't explain how this just magically started after flawless use for several months and is reproducible based on version.  Is something in these later versions making more frequent requests causing the rate limit to be triggered? Nothing has changed in my environment other than the HA version. No changes in HVAC usage either that would require more calls than usual. I don't even use the Train app on my phone anymore. 

I understand you are busy, but if you can help me identify what might have possibly changed along the way, I can try to help dig into it. 

I also wanted to submit a feature to you to request to get some attributes available to HA that the integration already seems to be pulling from the looks of the code. But that is something for another day.

There hasn't been any changes to the library that would cause this.  Here are all the changes in the last few months https://github.com/bdraco/nexia/compare/0.9.11...0.9.13

> I understand you are busy, but if you can help me identify what might have possibly changed along the way, I can try to help dig into it.

 I've personally observed this issue and tracked it down to the cloud service being flakey.   Connection problems are not always the same issue.  What I've seen may be a completely different issue that is only present in your setup, but thats not something I can track down since its not something present in all of mine.  

It likely could be worked around by increasing the backoff factor, but thats not something we want to do because it will tie up the connection pool and tie up the executor. The library needs to be converted to asyncio if we want to do that since backing off and sleeping (which is really just asking to be called later) in the event loop won't tie up any threads.
Thank you - it looks like you've put this through. I'll await the update. Cheers!
